_doc: [extras] Songs on the base radio (systems/extras/radio.gd). mood: a MusicDirector mood (audio/music_director.gd MOODS); the song_* moods are radio arrangements. cond: when the song unlocks, the same condition types as data/achievements.json plus 'districts_l5' (bases at level 5) and 'districts' (districts visited); no cond = on the radio from the start. hint: shown while locked. Unlocks persist in GameState.flags.radio.unlocked.

songs.name: First Light
songs.desc: The tune Lumi hums on a dusty morning.

songs.name: Workbench Waltz
songs.desc: Cozy chords for tinkering at the bench.

songs.name: Hopeful Static
songs.desc: What the radio picked up the night Lumi landed.

songs.name: Lantern Hours
songs.desc: Night music, slow and a little blue.

songs.name: Rust Lullaby
songs.desc: A music box found in a scrapyard, still in tune.

songs.name: Sprout Shuffle
songs.desc: Bouncy and green. The seedlings like this one.

songs.name: Old Town Rooftops
songs.desc: Evening jazz over the mended roofs.

songs.name: Greenline Express
songs.desc: A quick groove for a district that runs itself.

songs.name: Far Shore
songs.desc: Wide and airy, for the next district over the hill.

songs.name: Homeward
songs.desc: The swelling theme from Lumi's long fall.

songs.name: Verdance in Bloom
songs.desc: The whole planet in flower, in four chords.

songs.name: Cradle Choir
songs.desc: The ark's garden deck, remembered in slow swells.

songs.name: Starseed Serenade
songs.desc: A new world on the horizon, lydian and bright.
